sections.content: display controls layout behavior: block (full width, new line), inline (flows with text), inline-block (inline but sized), none (hidden), flex/grid (modern layouts).
Changing display is often the fix for "my div won't center" or "my span ignores width".
Key points: none removes from layout entirely (visibility:hidden only hides), flex/grid are for component layout, and display is not inherited but children react to parent context.
